मुण्ड १

MUṆḌA I . A warrior of the country of muṇḍa. In the great battle the Muṇḍas were present in the Kaurava's army. (Śloka 9, Chapter 56, bhīṣma parva).

मुण्डक

MUṆḌAKA . A forest. During his exile śrī rāma entered this great forest of muṇḍaka and paid homage to the sage agastya. (araṇya Kāṇḍa, Kamba rāmāyaṇa).

मुण्डवेदांग

MUṆḌAVEDĀṄGA . A serpent born of the family of dhṛtarāṣṭra. This serpent was burnt to death at the sarpasatra of janamejaya. (Śloka 17, Chapter 57, Ādi Parva).

मुण्डी

MUṆḌĪ . A female follower of subrahmaṇya. (Śloka 17, Chapter 46, śalya Parva).
